Priya (PM): Quick sync — I sketched a proposed minimal launch scope for Enterprise compliance features. Main asks: audit streaming + export, BYOK/KMS handshake, retention tiers (30d/1y/7y), and SOC2 evidence export. Need triage: what must ship v1 vs v2?
Andre (Security): Re: BYOK: MVP must include CMEK handle + rotation policy doc. We can delay HSM escrow integration to v2. Also need threat model update.
Matt (Eng): FYI infra constraints: audit streaming + realtime index will add ~2x ingestion QPS. Can we narrow retention SLA for v1 to 30d hot + 1y cold? 7y affects storage + search cost.
Sam (Legal): For enterprise finserv pilot we need 7y retention as an opt-in contract term. But legal hold/ediscovery must be available for exported evidence even if data is aged. Suggest make 7y an add-on.
Elena (CS): +1 on add-on. Several customers asked specifically for tenant-scoped search/export and a keystore handshake demo. Pilot customer (AlphaBank) will accept 1y default if 7y is available as paid extension.
Priya (PM): Proposed split: v1 = audit streaming, tenant-scoped export, BYOK handshake (CMEK in KMS mode), retention tiers configurable but default 30d/1y, SOC2 evidence export basic. v2 = full 7y archival, HSM escrow, advanced audit search SLA. Thoughts?
Andre (Security): That sounds reasonable. Important: v1 must log key rotation events + proof of destruction steps. Also require attestation docs for SOC2 scope.
Matt (Eng): Implementation notes:
```
- Audit pipeline: kafka -> transformer -> elastic / cold storage
- BYOK: support KMS decrypt/verify flow, no HSM API yet
- Retention: lifecycle jobs to snapshot->cold, then archive
```
We can deliver v1 in ~8 weeks with a 2-3 engineer focus + infra sprints.
OpsBot: Deploy plan reminder — schedule canary in prod region us-west-2, limit to 10 tenants for initial rollout.
Sam (Legal): Need checklist items for compliance readiness: evidence manifest, chain-of-custody, export integrity hashes. I'll draft the legal checklist and share by EOD.
Elena (CS): Customer comms: will draft email + playbook for customers to opt into 7y archival add-on. Also need pricing note.
Priya (PM): Decision needed: do we gate v1 on SOC2 audit completion, or ship SOC2-focused features behind a flag and require audit for GA? My recommendation: ship behind flag, require audit before enabling for customers in SOC2 scope.
Andre (Security): Ship behind flag. We must not enable SOC2 exports without signed attestation readiness.
Matt (Eng): Agree. Also recommend feature-flagged keystore UI disabled until KMS integration validated in staging.
Priya (PM): OK — action items:
- Andre: update threat model & attestation checklist (due +5d)
- Matt: timeline + infra cost estimate for 7y archival (due +7d)
- Sam: legal checklist for evidence export (due EOD)
- Elena: customer opt-in playbook + pricing stub (due +7d)
- Me: update roadmap doc and flag gating plan (due +3d)
Please react with :thumbsup: if aligned or reply with objections.
